name: 1-2-3-magic
title: 1-2-3 Magic: Effective Discipline for Children 2-12
author: Thomas W. Phelan
description: Thomas W. Phelan's "1-2-3 Magic" — the simple, evidence-based 3-step parenting program for children 2-12. Covers the counting method for Stop behavior (whining, fighting, arguing), 7 Start strategies (morning routines, chores, homework), strengthening parent-child relationships, handling the 6 types of testing and manipulation. Trigger when users say: "discipline" "parenting help" "toddler discipline" "child behavior" "stop whining" "tantrums."
